title: Shishak Invades Judah

questions.question: What happened when the rule of Rehoboam was established and he was strong?
options: He abandoned the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him
questions.correctAnswer: He abandoned the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:1 (ESV): "...he abandoned the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him."

questions.question: Who came up against Jerusalem in the fifth year of Rehoboam?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:2 (ESV): "In the fifth year of King Rehoboam... Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Why did Shishak come up?
options: Because they had been unfaithful to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Because they had been unfaithful to the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:2 (ESV): "...because they had been unfaithful to the LORD..."

questions.question: What words did Shemaiah speak to the princes?
options: Thus says the LORD, "You abandoned me, so I have abandoned you to the hand of Shishak."
questions.correctAnswer: Thus says the LORD, "You abandoned me, so I have abandoned you to the hand of Shishak."
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:5 (ESV): "...Thus says the LORD, 'You abandoned me, so I have abandoned you to the hand of Shishak.'"

questions.question: How did the princes and king respond to Shemaiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:6 (ESV): "Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves..."

questions.question: What happened because they humbled themselves?
options: The LORD said He would not destroy them but grant them some deliverance
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD said He would not destroy them but grant them some deliverance
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:7 (ESV): "...I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance..."

questions.question: What contrast did God want them to learn by serving Shishak?
options: That they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries
questions.correctAnswer: That they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:8 (ESV): "Nevertheless, they shall be servants to him, that they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries."

questions.question: What did Shishak take?
options: The treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house
questions.correctAnswer: The treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:9 (ESV): "So Shishak... took away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house. He took away everything."

questions.question: What specific item did Shishak take that Solomon had made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:9 (ESV): "...He also took away the shields of gold that Solomon had made."

questions.question: What did Rehoboam make to replace the gold shields?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:10 (ESV): "And King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze..."

questions.question: How many chariots did Shishak have?
How many horsemen did Shishak have?
Who were the people who came with Shishak?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:3 (ESV): "...the Libyans, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians."

questions.question: At what age did Rehoboam begin to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:13 (ESV): "Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: Who was Rehoboam's mother?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 12:13 (ESV): "...His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite."

key_verse_text: And he did evil, for he did not set his heart to seek the LORD.
